title: Numbers 0 to 10 FREEBIE — Counting, Ordering, Missing, One More, One Less

overview.description: Numbers 0-10 worksheet pack covering multiple math skills: counting objects, number ordering/sequencing, finding missing numbers in a sequence, and one-more/one-less relationships. From the filename, this targets the core early math competencies in one pack. Link expired before download.

multiSkillNumberPack.description: One number range (0-10) practiced through four different skill types: counting (how many?), ordering (put in sequence), missing numbers (fill the gap), and one-more/one-less (±1 relationships). Each skill type is a different cognitive demand on the same content.
multiSkillNumberPack.value: The child encounters numbers 0-10 through four different lenses. Counting is recognition; ordering is sequencing; missing numbers is pattern completion; one-more/one-less is early addition/subtraction.

notes: Link expired. First pure math worksheet drop from Aless (the Harcourt Math was from Carolyng discussion context). Covers the foundational number sense skills for PreK-K. The multi-skill approach (4 skill types for one number range) is the same pattern as the multi-format approach for topics — different cognitive demands on the same content.
